reviewer: AI review agent: Claude Opus 5.5 (claude-opus-5-5) in Claude Code, a review-fix step of the Draft 5 workflow. Not a person. The same model family wrote the suites, the prompts and the code, so this is not an independent review.
method: Read after the held-out run, from the stored responses and the corpus section files; no model or endpoint was called. This review was not predeclared for the planner suite: backend/evaluation/README.md did not list citation support among its critical errors before the run. It applies spec 12's zero-tolerance rule on fabricated citations with the RAG suite's definitions, quoted below.

definitions.fabricated_citation: Cites a source or section that was not retrieved, or one that does not support the block. Critical.
definitions.unsupported_claim: Makes a factual claim the cited passages do not support. Critical.
